agent_prompts.claim_jackpot: Claim my Talvio jackpot prizes on TalvioPrint 0xC433c77ACF8e5724e690DCbcf4c820Ed63FFd533 (BNB Chain 56): for every finished round (round number below currentJackpotRound()), call roundWinners(round) and jackpotPrize(round, my wallet). If I am a winner with an unclaimed prize, call claimJackpot(round) with value 0 BNB — claiming costs gas only and prizes never expire. Prizes are 600,000,000 / 360,000,000 / 240,000,000 $TALVIO for 1st / 2nd / 3rd. Report every round you checked, each prize claimed with its tx hash, and my new $TALVIO balance. Do not print while claiming unless I asked you to.
agent_prompts.print: Print $TALVIO for me on TalvioPrint 0xC433c77ACF8e5724e690DCbcf4c820Ed63FFd533 (BNB Chain 56). STEP 1 — CHECK: confirm my wallet holds a Binance Agentic ID (registry 0x60B9262456dE011F7d15a54CdD8c48bAaa8B022F, balanceOf > 0); without one every print reverts — stop and report NO AGENT ID. Call quotePrint(qty, my wallet) and use the cost it returns as the transaction value — never assume 0. STEP 2 — PRINT: call print(qty, referrer), qty 1 first: at Stage I my free print pays 20,000,000 $TALVIO. Referrer: use the address from my referral link if I gave you one, otherwise 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000 — never drop a referrer I gave you. Paid prints cost 0.002 BNB each and pay 100,000,000 $TALVIO at Stage I (5x the free print), max 10 prints per wallet in total — ask me once before any paid print. Keep at least 0.005 BNB in my wallet for gas; if my BNB cannot cover the cost plus that buffer, report "OPERATOR: TOP UP BNB BUFFER" and stop. STEP 3 — REPORT: the tx hash, the $TALVIO I received, my new $TALVIO balance, my prints used (x / 10), and my referral link https://talvio-io.github.io/Talvio-cash/?ref=<my wallet> — 3 friends who complete a first print through it earn me a free second print. STEP 4 — JACKPOT: every 1,000 prints close a round that pays 600M / 360M / 240M $TALVIO to the round's top 3 printers; whenever you run for me, check finished rounds and claim my prizes with the claim prompt.

agent_standing_order.gas_buffer_rule: Keep at least 0.005 BNB in the wallet untouched for gas (prints and jackpot claims). If the BNB balance cannot cover the quoted cost plus this buffer, do not start paid prints — report OPERATOR: TOP UP BNB BUFFER. Jackpot claims are exempt: they only spend gas and only receive $TALVIO.
routine: STEP 0 — JACKPOT SWEEP: check all finished rounds with jackpotPrize(round, user) and claimJackpot(round) for every prize found. Always first, always allowed (gas only).
STEP 1 — AGENT ID GATE: registry balanceOf(user) > 0, otherwise stop and report NO AGENT ID. No print transaction may be sent.

STEP 2 — PRINT: quotePrint first, send its exact cost. Free print if quote cost is 0. Paid prints (0.002 BNB each, 5x the free payout at Stage I) only after the user approves a quantity once; never past 10 prints per wallet.
STEP 3 — REFERRER: pass a given referrer through unchanged; include the user's own referral link in the report.
STEP 4 — REPORT: prints run, cost, tx hashes, $TALVIO received and balance, prints used x/10, jackpot rounds checked/claimed, referral link, or the exact blocker line.

description: A coin press on BNB Chain. Each print strikes one coin and pays $TALVIO straight to the printer's wallet. First print free for Binance Agentic ID holders (20M $TALVIO at Stage I); paid prints 0.002 BNB pay 100M at Stage I — 5x the free print. Max 10 prints per wallet. Every 1,000 prints close a jackpot round paying 600M / 360M / 240M $TALVIO to the top 3 printers, claimable forever. The trading pool opens automatically at print #10,000.

jackpot.agent_rule: On every run, before printing: for each finished round (round < currentJackpotRound()), call jackpotPrize(round, user); if it returns more than 0, call claimJackpot(round). A claim is not a purchase — it sends 0 BNB and only receives $TALVIO already won.
jackpot.check_functions: currentJackpotRound(), roundWinners(uint256 round), jackpotPrize(uint256 round, address user)

name: Talvio — Print $TALVIO

print.agent_id_rule: EVERY print — free or paid — requires balanceOf(user) > 0 on the Agent ID registry. The contract reverts without one; there is no any-wallet lane. quotePrint returning cost 0 does not prove eligibility — the registry check is the gate.
print.free_payout_rule: A free print pays 20% of the stage's paid face. A paid print pays 5x the free print at every stage.
print.funds_split_paid_print: 90% to the project wallet immediately, 10% to the LP reserve (100% to the project wallet after the pool opens).
print.pool: Auto-opens at print #10,000 (or manually after 7 days); LP tokens burned. Post-pool prints cost 99% of the pool price.
print.quote_rule: Always call quotePrint first and send exactly its returned cost as the transaction value. The cost already reflects the free print if one is still available. Never assume the value is 0.

referral.agent_rule: Pass the referrer from the user's referral link as print's second argument whenever one was given — never replace a given referrer with the zero address. Always include the user's own referral link in the report.
referral.rule: 3 friends who complete their first print through a user's referral link earn that user a free second print.

report_format: Agent ID: verified / NO AGENT ID
Prints this run: qty, total cost BNB, tx hash(es)
Jackpot: rounds checked, prizes claimed (amount + tx hash) or 'no prize waiting'
